items.title: Buddy Burns and Frank Pasley Interview, 1968-09-23
items.q: Well I know, him and George, George played the trumpet.

ctx.x: I can show you a picture of Oliver. That's him. Yeah. Yeah, that's Alvin. Do you know who gave me this picture? Mrs. Nolling. Miss who? Nolling. I don't know. Ransom Nolling, the bass player. I don't know. I got his address. Yeah, I got it too. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. 61 and something. That's right. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
Those, those, why had to raise up with those boys. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Do you, do you know if he was related to George McCollum Jr.?
Yeah. Cousins. Cousins? Mm-hm. Not half-brothers? Somebody told me they were half-brothers.
